title: Coordinate query probability bounded by revealment
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite input alphabet with probability law $\pi$, and let $T$ be a randomized decision tree with finite nonempty seed space. For every coordinate $i$, its probability of being queried under independent inputs of law $\pi$ is at most the revealment of $T$ under $\pi$, defined as the maximum query probability over all coordinates, or $0$ if there are no coordinates.
hypotheses_covered: Randomized decision tree with finite nonempty seed space and seed law
